flora: Mature Tōtara (massive, wide trunks, dense rounded crowns of dark green)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; massive, sturdy tree silhouettes; creating a sense of permanence and age; warm Jurassic river-valley atmosphere.

visual_logic.composition: A wide-angle view of a sunlit river terrace. Several massive Tōtara trees stand as the dominant features. Their trunks are huge and textured. The ground is a mix of red-brown earth and patches of forest-green moss. The river glints in the background.
visual_logic.ground: Firm, well-drained red-brown soil with scattered ochre river stones.
visual_logic.lighting: Warm, direct sunlight that emphasizes the deep red-brown tones of the earth and the rugged texture of the tree trunks.
